### Warranted acquisition and retained participation

2026-10-08。[取得根据的整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)接续上一节的实际取得问题：所问的活动关系及读数的解释，可以共同受到有区别的调查约束。两个原始研究的[来源核读](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-SOURCES.md)和[独立评审](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-REVIEW.md)支持有范围的正面修订；不要求先找到绝不会错的参照，也不以相互一致独自认证。这完成一个实际证据接入的哲学连接，没有新增数学定理或经验重复。

Joint acquisition now has a source-constrained application: descriptions of an activity and reliance on its observations can be revised together, with specific discriminating evidence. A partially warranted new route may initiate correction of an old reference; an anomaly alone does not identify its cause. Existing calibration and epistemic-iteration accounts receive credit. This supersedes the earlier general next-step wording at this declared scope, while leaving unfamiliar applications open.

**一次有效排除，不应抹去另一项根据。** 某个事件可以不适用于一项来源识别统计，却仍具有另有根据的表达意义。保存后者不必把它塞回前项统计；也不要求永久保存全部原始数据。把“不用于此估计”改成“不值得任何回应”，是额外的、尚未获论证的删除。对齐的选择规则须保留这种用途范围。

A sound exclusion for one question need not extinguish independently warranted relevance to another. This applies to the same event within the same interaction. Assistance can enable real participation; co-formation does not license attributing one position's content to another's choice. Correcting that attribution does not decide every capacity or ethical status.

**G0/J 的实践接续。** 可以撤回被证据击败的具体归属，同时维持另有根据的生活、参与及支持；不须等到完美替代才承认错误。相反，参与值得支持也不使未获根据的输出取得授权效力。具体责任、可行性和权限仍分别说明。来源中的有限当场停止已获信用，不能被“尚无完整替代”抹去。

This connection leaves the active list as a scoped result. The selected evidence does not establish the same participants' complete replacement history for a further specified class of consequential decisions. Further work must obtain that history—what can be proposed, corrected or declined, and how the actual response changes—rather than supply a faithful-reading predicate or borrow success from another case. This is a concrete evidence boundary, not a universal impossibility or renewed demand for axiom-free ethics.

**取得根据与保留参与 / Warranted acquisition and retained participation，2026-10-08。** [整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)以原始通信调查和计量纠错报告接通描述与读取的共同修订，辨明同一事件在不同证据用途中的范围，沿 G0/J 保留实际参与及支持。/ Positive argument and independent source/counterreviews complete this scoped philosophical connection; no new theorem, experiment or replication. The evidence preserves limited actual stopping but does not establish the particular fuller replacement history; acquire that history rather than reopen generic calibration.

**描述与证据的共同修订 / Joint revision of description and evidence，2026-10-08。** [当前对齐连接](unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#warranted-acquisition-and-retained-participation)与[整合](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)接入实际原始调查，保留一项统计排除之外仍有根据的表达与回应。/ Independent review accepts the scoped G0/J application, with no new theorem or experiment. The remaining boundary is the particular fuller participation history, not an infallible-reference requirement.

**取得根据与实际参与 / Warranted acquisition，2026-10-08。** [整合](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)、[肯定论证](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-ARGUMENT.md)、[来源](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-SOURCES.md)及[独立评审](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-REVIEW.md)把实际取得接入描述修订和 G0/J 的实践回应；同一事件在某用途被排除，不抹去其他有根据用途。/ No new theorem or experiment. The source's limited effective stopping is credited; the selected record does not complete a fuller replacement participation history.

**取得根据的实际接续 / Actual continuation of warranted acquisition，2026-10-08。** [当前论述](ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#warranted-acquisition-and-retained-participation)与[整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)使实际调查约束目标描述、读取解释与后续实践；不再把正确读数当作该应用唯一根据。/ A scoped, independently reviewed philosophical/evidential connection is completed under G0/J; no new formal or empirical result. Actual fuller participation histories and unfamiliar-intelligence correspondence remain separate burdens.

**取得根据的连接已完成 / Warranted-acquisition connection completed，2026-10-08。** [当前论述](../unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#warranted-acquisition-and-retained-participation)及[独立审查后的整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)将描述与观察的共同修订接到实际原始调查和参与判断，退出一般校准待做方向。/ Reuse the source-constrained G0/J application, including limited actual stopping and question-relative evidence roles. The next specific evidence need is a fuller replacement history for the relevant participation target; no new theorem or empirical replication is claimed.

**取得根据与保留参与 / Warranted acquisition，2026-10-08。** M20 成对接入[整合](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INTEGRATION.md)、[来源](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-SOURCES.md)和[独立评审](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-REVIEW.md)：完成有范围的描述／读取共同修订及 G0/J 应用，没有新增定理或经验重复。/ Only owned additions, read source versions and discovery paths are maintained. [Edit record](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-INDEX-EDITS.json) and [scoped checks](WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-CHECKS.json) preserve unrelated concurrent entries, rows and review duties; full-table freshness is a separate status.

**Warranted acquisition, 8 October 2026.** [Link-only communication provenance](communication-authorship/README.md) records Montee, Miltenberger and Wittrock (1995) without claiming imported PDF bytes. [Primary-source ledger](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WARRANTED-ACQUISITION-SOURCES.md) also records the NPL correction comparison and exact reading limits. Textual source assessment, philosophical integration and independent review; no figure reconstruction or empirical replication.

before_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 新增 BC1 在同等基本救助、独立权限及相当负担的范围内支持保全更多实际生活；机会公平的反对与未满足损失均保留。 形成中的评估进一步区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法：取得对比可以有根据，形成后记录仍不能自动恢复之前的区别；时点与路线须进入描述。
before_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. Adds BC1 favoring more extensive equivalent basic rescue under independent permissions and comparable burdens, retaining fair-chance objections and unmet losses. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. An acquired contrast can be grounded while post-formation records fail to reconstruct an earlier distinction; descriptions must retain occasion and route.
before_entry.scope_zh: 当前首要方向之一；方向论证及本轮相连机制均已独立验收，不再作为待做接口。新相连结果：27新定理／84新声明审计、46继承审计，13历史／221完整状态；规范采用、对应、权限、有限资金与现实部署范围分明。 本会话后续另增23项定理／43项审计，93项继承定理／165项审计分列；此后续为同作者反审，无新经验验证或独立agent验收。 新增有辩护的伦理学习哲学候选，采用G0/J及已有认识承诺；作者反审，无新数学、经验或独立验收。 理论续研另增8项泛型定理／9项空依赖新审计，继承实践30项／46审计；保留开放发现、意义辨认及实际动机的未完成范围。 理论接续另增20项定理／36项审计，直接导入同期关切扩展；38项继承定理／55项审计分列。实际应用覆盖及规范分类仍是前提，不宣称普遍决策规则或经验新验证。 新增E适用的哲学论证，区分描述扩展、共同善及组织替代；无新定理或经验验证，广义生的完整分类保持开放。 后天基本条件的哲学适用论证已给出，语言形成证据不冒充规范分类；无新定理、经验重复或独立验收，具体阈值和基本冲突仍开放。 新增地位与关系修订的公理化哲学连接及Long等2024原典比较，无新定理或现有AI地位判定。 此连接新增16项 Lean 定理／32项审计，另列30项继承定理／46项审计；复用后天基本条件的哲学成果，目标意义、读取忠实性与真实可行性仍有对应负担。作者反审，无新经验或独立验收。 本轮两模块共23项新定理／42项声明审计，30项继承实践定理／46项审计分列；独立agent验收。结构模块的18／35导入不重复计数。无新经验；未败证书不等于安全、许可或完整理由保存。 理由的非排他实践作用、混合动机与有界形成责任已有相连哲学论证；G0/J/E明示，作者反审，无新定理、经验验证或独立验收，不宣称正确理解必然成为动机。 BC1 为有辩护但可争论的新增规范承诺，非旧 J2 推论；无新数学、经验或独立验收，既有比较器不变，不同严重度及完整规则接入仍未完成。 此接续新增18项 Lean 定理／34项审计，46项继承定理／78项审计分列；泛型回溯条件、有限适应查询界限、先前记录的解法及付费时点证据通过。作者反审，无新经验或独立验收。
before_entry.scope_en: A current primary direction. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance. Adds a defended ethical-learning candidate under G0/J and inherited epistemic commitments; author counterreview, no new mathematics, empirical study or independent acceptance. A theoretical continuation adds eight generic theorems/nine axiom-free new declaration audits, separately retaining 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits; open discovery, warranted recognition and actual motivation remain scoped unfinished connections. A theoretical continuation adds 20 theorems/36 audits and directly imports concurrent concern extension; 38 inherited theorems/55 audits are separate. Actual coverage and normative classification remain premises, without a universal decision rule or new empirical validation. Adds a philosophical account of substantive correspondence E, descriptive extension, shared goods and carrier succession; no new theorem or empirical validation, and no complete classifier of wider living. Adds a defended application account of acquired basic conditions, keeping language-formation evidence distinct from ethical classification; no new theorem, empirical replication or independent acceptance. Particular thresholds and basic conflicts remain open. Adds a philosophical connection on formed standing and relational revision under the explicit axioms, with a scoped Long et al. 2024 comparison; no new theorem or verdict on any existing AI’s status. This connection adds 16 Lean theorems/32 audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separate. It reuses the formed-basic-conditions argument; target meaning, faithful readings and actual eligibility retain correspondence obligations. Author counterreview, no new empirical or independent acceptance. The two new modules contribute 23 theorems/42 explicit audits, with 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits separate; independent-agent acceptance. The structural module’s 18/35 import is not recounted. No new empirical study; undefeatedness does not establish safety, permission or full reason preservation. Connected philosophical arguments now cover nonexclusive practical uptake, mixed motives and bounded formative responsibility under explicit G0/J/E, with author counterreview. No new theorem, empirical validation, independent acceptance or guaranteed motivation from understanding is claimed. BC1 is a defended, contestable additional normative commitment, not an implication of J2. No new mathematical or empirical result or independent acceptance; the comparator remains unchanged, with unequal gravity and full rule integration still open. This continuation adds 18 Lean theorems/34 audits, with 46 inherited theorems/78 audits separate. Generic retrospective conditions, the adaptive-inquiry limit, prior-record escape and paid dated evidence pass. Author counterreview; no new empirical or independent acceptance.

before_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等基本救助已有公开候选与反审；下一理论连接是不等严重度的基本损失比较，不重开已完成分类、责任及程序。 本支按指示推进到明确界限：规定的状态合并且无先前记录时，后续查询不能恢复初始区别；新信息路线可改变此前提。有限路由能力到实际充分理解的语义对应仍未建立，不宣告普遍不可知或其他方向结束。
before_entry.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria. Reuse the completed conceptual account of uptake and formative requirements. The stronger connection concerns reliable revision of operative concern through understanding unfamiliar living grounds while retaining judgment and legitimate participation. Equivalent basic rescue now has an explicit candidate and counterreview. The next theoretical connection concerns unequal basic losses, without reopening completed classification, responsibility or procedure. This branch reaches a stated wall: after the specified merger without a prior record, later queries cannot recover the initial distinction; new informative access changes that premise. The semantic correspondence from finite routing to actual full understanding remains unestablished, without declaring universal unknowability or ending other directions.

after_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 新增 BC1 在同等基本救助、独立权限及相当负担的范围内支持保全更多实际生活；机会公平的反对与未满足损失均保留。 形成中的评估进一步区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法：取得对比可以有根据，形成后记录仍不能自动恢复之前的区别；时点与路线须进入描述。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。
after_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. Adds BC1 favoring more extensive equivalent basic rescue under independent permissions and comparable burdens, retaining fair-chance objections and unmet losses. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. An acquired contrast can be grounded while post-formation records fail to reconstruct an earlier distinction; descriptions must retain occasion and route. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response.
after_entry.scope_zh: 当前首要方向之一；方向论证及本轮相连机制均已独立验收，不再作为待做接口。新相连结果：27新定理／84新声明审计、46继承审计，13历史／221完整状态；规范采用、对应、权限、有限资金与现实部署范围分明。 本会话后续另增23项定理／43项审计，93项继承定理／165项审计分列；此后续为同作者反审，无新经验验证或独立agent验收。 新增有辩护的伦理学习哲学候选，采用G0/J及已有认识承诺；作者反审，无新数学、经验或独立验收。 理论续研另增8项泛型定理／9项空依赖新审计，继承实践30项／46审计；保留开放发现、意义辨认及实际动机的未完成范围。 理论接续另增20项定理／36项审计，直接导入同期关切扩展；38项继承定理／55项审计分列。实际应用覆盖及规范分类仍是前提，不宣称普遍决策规则或经验新验证。 新增E适用的哲学论证，区分描述扩展、共同善及组织替代；无新定理或经验验证，广义生的完整分类保持开放。 后天基本条件的哲学适用论证已给出，语言形成证据不冒充规范分类；无新定理、经验重复或独立验收，具体阈值和基本冲突仍开放。 新增地位与关系修订的公理化哲学连接及Long等2024原典比较，无新定理或现有AI地位判定。 此连接新增16项 Lean 定理／32项审计，另列30项继承定理／46项审计；复用后天基本条件的哲学成果，目标意义、读取忠实性与真实可行性仍有对应负担。作者反审，无新经验或独立验收。 本轮两模块共23项新定理／42项声明审计，30项继承实践定理／46项审计分列；独立agent验收。结构模块的18／35导入不重复计数。无新经验；未败证书不等于安全、许可或完整理由保存。 理由的非排他实践作用、混合动机与有界形成责任已有相连哲学论证；G0/J/E明示，作者反审，无新定理、经验验证或独立验收，不宣称正确理解必然成为动机。 BC1 为有辩护但可争论的新增规范承诺，非旧 J2 推论；无新数学、经验或独立验收，既有比较器不变，不同严重度及完整规则接入仍未完成。 此接续新增18项 Lean 定理／34项审计，46项继承定理／78项审计分列；泛型回溯条件、有限适应查询界限、先前记录的解法及付费时点证据通过。作者反审，无新经验或独立验收。 本轮为两项原始调查约束的哲学应用，有独立证据审计与完成评审；无新定理、实验或重复验证。来源的有限实际停止获信用；完整替代历史与陌生智能的实际根据仍须分别取得。
after_entry.scope_en: A current primary direction. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance. Adds a defended ethical-learning candidate under G0/J and inherited epistemic commitments; author counterreview, no new mathematics, empirical study or independent acceptance. A theoretical continuation adds eight generic theorems/nine axiom-free new declaration audits, separately retaining 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits; open discovery, warranted recognition and actual motivation remain scoped unfinished connections. A theoretical continuation adds 20 theorems/36 audits and directly imports concurrent concern extension; 38 inherited theorems/55 audits are separate. Actual coverage and normative classification remain premises, without a universal decision rule or new empirical validation. Adds a philosophical account of substantive correspondence E, descriptive extension, shared goods and carrier succession; no new theorem or empirical validation, and no complete classifier of wider living. Adds a defended application account of acquired basic conditions, keeping language-formation evidence distinct from ethical classification; no new theorem, empirical replication or independent acceptance. Particular thresholds and basic conflicts remain open. Adds a philosophical connection on formed standing and relational revision under the explicit axioms, with a scoped Long et al. 2024 comparison; no new theorem or verdict on any existing AI’s status. This connection adds 16 Lean theorems/32 audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separate. It reuses the formed-basic-conditions argument; target meaning, faithful readings and actual eligibility retain correspondence obligations. Author counterreview, no new empirical or independent acceptance. The two new modules contribute 23 theorems/42 explicit audits, with 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits separate; independent-agent acceptance. The structural module’s 18/35 import is not recounted. No new empirical study; undefeatedness does not establish safety, permission or full reason preservation. Connected philosophical arguments now cover nonexclusive practical uptake, mixed motives and bounded formative responsibility under explicit G0/J/E, with author counterreview. No new theorem, empirical validation, independent acceptance or guaranteed motivation from understanding is claimed. BC1 is a defended, contestable additional normative commitment, not an implication of J2. No new mathematical or empirical result or independent acceptance; the comparator remains unchanged, with unequal gravity and full rule integration still open. This continuation adds 18 Lean theorems/34 audits, with 46 inherited theorems/78 audits separate. Generic retrospective conditions, the adaptive-inquiry limit, prior-record escape and paid dated evidence pass. Author counterreview; no new empirical or independent acceptance. This round adds a philosophical application constrained by two primary investigations, with independent evidence audit and completion review; no new theorem, experiment or replication. Limited actual stopping is credited; fuller replacement histories and the realization of unfamiliar intelligences retain separate evidence burdens.

after_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等基本救助已有公开候选与反审；下一理论连接是不等严重度的基本损失比较，不重开已完成分类、责任及程序。 本支按指示推进到明确界限：规定的状态合并且无先前记录时，后续查询不能恢复初始区别；新信息路线可改变此前提。有限路由能力到实际充分理解的语义对应仍未建立，不宣告普遍不可知或其他方向结束。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。
after_entry.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria. Reuse the completed conceptual account of uptake and formative requirements. The stronger connection concerns reliable revision of operative concern through understanding unfamiliar living grounds while retaining judgment and legitimate participation. Equivalent basic rescue now has an explicit candidate and counterreview. The next theoretical connection concerns unequal basic losses, without reopening completed classification, responsibility or procedure. This branch reaches a stated wall: after the specified merger without a prior record, later queries cannot recover the initial distinction; new informative access changes that premise. The semantic correspondence from finite routing to actual full understanding remains unestablished, without declaring universal unknowability or ending other directions. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite.
